title: A Chicago shooting star
done: You made a shooting star! A bumblebee has to buzz to shake the pollen out of it.

steps.say: Put a tall purple triangle flat on the table, pointing up. A petal!
Put another tall purple triangle next to it.
One more tall purple triangle. The petals swoosh up, like a shooting star. Real ones are pink or white; we use purple.
Put a yellow square under the middle petal.
Put a yellow triangle under that, pointing down. The tail!
Put a small green triangle at the bottom left. A leaf.
Put a small green triangle at the bottom right.
